_about: Batch B4 (graphs, DBO, patches). Owner: B4 writer. Search all glossary files before adding a term.

dbo-yield.short: A custom op that hands control to the other ubatch thread. The AFD proxy calls it between the send and the receive, so the second stage runs while the first waits.
dbo-yield.long: Registered as torch.ops.vllm.manual_dbo_yield ({{cite afd_plugin/v1/worker/dbo.py:27-49}}). It yields only when vLLM DBO is active ({{cite afd_plugin/v1/worker/dbo.py:52-54}}).

ffn-graph-key.short: A hashable key built from the per-stage DP metadata. The FFN runner uses it to store and look up one captured CUDA graph per token shape.

version-gate.short: A check that decides whether a patch installs. is_target_vllm_compatible allows the target vLLM release and any dev build; on a mismatch, no patch installs.
version-gate.long: Defined in is_target_vllm_compatible ({{cite afd_plugin/compat/vllm.py:53-68}}). Different from the strict start-up check assert_vllm_version_supported ({{cite afd_plugin/compat/vllm.py:38-50}}).

scoped-patch.short: A patch that is active only inside a context manager, for the time of one AFD call. The code restores the original function on exit.
scoped-patch.long: Example: use_gpu_mrv2_ubatch_factory and use_gpu_mrv2_dbo_dispatch scope the DP1 DBO seams ({{cite afd_plugin/compat/patches/gpu_mrv2_ubatching.py:263-282}}).

acl-graph.short: The Ascend NPU form of a captured graph, the NPU counterpart of a CUDA graph. The NPU validator accepts the FULL and FULL_DECODE_ONLY modes.
acl-graph.long: The NPU runtime is covered on {{link concepts/npu-overview}}. The mode check is {{cite afd_plugin/validation.py:233-239}}.
